about:
Action Solar is based in Lehi, Utah, and operates across 22 states. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders in the provided materials, nor does it specify an ownership structure such as family-, veteran-, or woman-owned.

The firm installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems and offers new-home solar solutions. In the past three years it has completed more than 2,750 projects totaling over 557 megawatts of installed capacity, delivering an estimated $1.41 billion in customer energy savings and offsetting 106 million tons of carbon. The process moves from consultation and site assessment through design, permitting, installation, and assistance with federal and local incentives.

Customers include homeowners seeking lower utility bills and higher property values, as well as commercial clients such as Walmart and Extra Space Storage that use solar to stabilize energy costs and improve sustainability profiles. The company also serves builders integrating solar into new construction.

Action Solar states its mission is to advance renewable energy by making solar power affordable and accessible, helping customers achieve energy independence and contributing to a universally sustainable future.
